decisions.reason: As a dietary supplement range with several models and dedicated web presence, it has demonstrated demand and low keeping costs, so the option remains valuable.
The dedicated page and quantified launch indicate established demand, and its synergy with the core offer justifies keeping the option open.
Although only mentioned on the website, its low-cost fit with the established offer and still-unresolved demand prospects make it worth keeping for now.
As a distant OTC triptan with higher marketing costs and little evidence of success after three years, the option's value is unlikely to justify further commitment.
